credits.title: Strawberries
credits.overview: Hasna and Meriem leave their native Morocco to work a season picking strawberries in Spain, until abuse and harassment shatter their hopes. Supported by a Spanish lawyer, they must decide whether to speak out against a powerful system.

credits.title: Bad Weather
credits.overview: Ten-year-old Ayoub lives with his family in a modest apartment inherited from his grandfather. As winter begins, his uncle demands his share of the inheritance but the home's only bathroom lies on his side sparking a tense family conflict.

credits.title: Deserts
credits.overview: Longtime friends, Mehdi and Hamid, work for a collection agency. They crisscross the villages of southern Morocco in their old car and share double rooms in shabby hotels. credits.title: قبل ما يفوت الفوت
credits.overview: Nezha a young widow working in a modest café, returns to her family home after years away to circumcise her 8-year-old son Ali. Only to face buried memories, family tensions, and the quiet weight of time that has slipped through her hands.

credits.title: Unexpected
credits.overview: A successful surgeon in Casablanca plans to marry into a rich family, but the family rejects him because his social level does not suit the family. However, he resorts to marrying into his tribe in the Middle Atlas to obtain his inheritance, but his life and projects turn around unexpectedly.

credits.title: Oasis Dreams
credits.overview: In a remote Moroccan oasis, a family shelters an injured Malian migrant fleeing border authorities. His unexpected arrival disrupts their lives, exposing tensions between tradition, compassion and human solidarity.

credits.title: The Silence of the Memory
credits.overview: Suffering from Alzheimer's, a retired employee leaves his family's home, while his two children, Maryam and Adel, who have conflicting feelings towards him, try to find him. However, the son's return to his homeland leads him to meet his old love and revisit memories of the past.

credits.title: Anger
credits.overview: Omar, the miller's son, has been in love with Laila, the daughter of the local landowner, since childhood. In adulthood, Omar has become a promising journalist and writer. He still loves Laila, but she has promised herself to someone else to save her family from bankruptcy...

credits.title: Women in Mirrors
credits.overview: A Moroccan photographer lives in Paris. She receives a call from the country she had left for ten years ago at the death of her father, informing her that her mother is seriously ill. She decides to go in spite of herself.

credits.title: The Shadows of Death
credits.overview: When Leila agrees to visit her boyfriend’s rural farm, she expects an intimate, relaxing weekend away from the city. Instead, the secluded setting becomes a pressure cooker when she meets his aunt.
